BearerAuth.description: OAuth2 access token from Ory Network

slug.description: Virtual tenant name used to build service URLs (e.g. Grafana).

autoJoin.description: When true, users who authenticate via SSO are automatically added as members.

userId.description: Ory subject ID of the user to invite.

hpcOperator.description: Mistral HPC Operator for managed Slurm clusters with pre-configured storage, per-user login nodes, and active health checks

changes.description: For update operations, contains changed fields with old and new values.

nextCursor.description: Timestamp cursor for the next page. Null if no more results.

maxClusters.description: Maximum number of clusters. -1 means unlimited.

currentClusters.description: Current number of clusters in the region.

maxStorageGb.description: Maximum storage in GB. -1 means unlimited.

currentStorageGb.description: Current storage usage in GB across all clusters in the region.

WebhookTokenCreated.description: OIDC credentials for NVSentinel event exporter. The client secret is only shown once.

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret. Only returned at creation time.

tokenUrl.description: OAuth2 token endpoint for client_credentials flow.

count.description: Number of times this event has been observed.

lastSeenAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent occurrence (null if count is 1).

nextCursor.description: Timestamp cursor for the next page. Null if no more results.

linearResolveStateId.description: Linear workflow state ID to transition issues to on resolution.

linearLabelIds.description: Linear label IDs to apply to created issues.

NotificationChannelFilters.description: Optional routing filters. If empty or omitted, the channel receives all events.

SlackChannelConfig.description: Slack configuration (bot token is never returned).

LinearChannelConfig.description: Linear configuration (API key is never returned).
